newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Avantel announces new cross-border rates.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Avantel announces new cross-border rates.

text.p: Avantel, one of Mexico's new long-distance telephone service operators, announced a new tariff on Monday for businesses and residential clients near the U.S.-Mexico border who make frequent cross-border calls.

The joint venture between Mexican banking group Banamex Accival and MCI Communications Corp said clients within 45 miles (75-kms) south of the border would get discounts when calling within 55 miles (88 kms) north of the border when the cost of the calls exceeds 130 pesos per month.
It said the discount, aimed chiefly at businesses along the border, would mean the rates per minute after the 130-peso threshold would be $1.84 by day and $1.23 by night.
